D.label: DOOR
D.text: The lab door. It stays shut unless you are wearing goggles and an apron.
D.name: Lab door

L.label: LOCKER
L.name: PPE locker
L.text: Goggles and aprons. Suit up here before you go in.

A.label: FIRST AID
A.text: First-aid kit: bandages, burn gel and gauze. Burns get cool running water first.
A.name: First-aid kit

1.label: UNKNOWNS
1.name: Unknown bottles shelf
1.text: The unknown bottles. They unlock when all six salts and NaNO3 are recorded.

K.label: SINK
K.text: The sink. Rinse glassware here. Never pour anything down it unless your teacher says it is safe.
K.name: Sink

H.label: HOOD
H.text: The fume hood. Not needed for today's lab, but vapors that smell or sting belong in here.
H.name: Fume hood

Y.label: EYEWASH
Y.text: The eyewash station. If a chemical gets in your eye, you rinse here for 15 minutes.
Y.name: Eyewash station

W.label: WASTE
W.text: Waste bins: broken glass in the hard box, chemical waste in the labeled jug.
W.name: Waste bins

F.label: EXTING.
F.text: A fire extinguisher. Pull the pin, aim at the base, squeeze, sweep.
F.name: Fire extinguisher

B.label: FLAME BENCH
B.text: The flame bench: a burner, a box of splints, seven salt bottles and a spectroscope.
B.name: Flame bench
